label.purpose: Table headers, status pills and compact metadata.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Account menu and snackbar only (the only legal overlay shadow value).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global reduced-motion override for transitions and animations.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Wrap toolbars and stack selected task, history, settings and Pixiv browser controls.

density.name: control-density
density.purpose: Material Web outlined text fields and selects unified via size-token overrides only (main.css control-density layer: top/bottom space 8px, input text 14px, line height 24px); buttons keep Material defaults; component appearance untouched.

components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Material Web primary action such as start, save, resume or confirm.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Material Web secondary action such as browse, sync or batch delete.

components.name: Form Controls
components.description: Material Web controls for source IDs, settings and selection, unified to 40px height and 14px input text by control-density size tokens (main.css); appearance untouched.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: 256px left navigation that collapses to 72px; active item uses primary-container.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Native dialog styled with surface-container, 28px radius and a scrim; Material Web's dialog component is not used.

components.name: Task Progress
components.description: Material Web linear progress paired with text-first status and metadata.

components.name: Snackbar
components.description: Global top-right notification that disappears after 3.2 seconds.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: History and task lists offer 20, 50, or 100 rows per page.

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Browse artwork card: 12px rounded cover, two-line title, pill badges for page count and R-18 (ink/surface), hover 8% primary state layer, no shadow. Whole card is clickable; cover-corner quick actions (see Card Quick Actions) render on browse channel cards only.

components.name: Card Quick Actions
components.description: Cover-corner quick actions on browse channel cards: 28px pill icon buttons in surface-container/ink, revealed on hover or focus-within, 8%/12% primary state layers, reduced-motion aware; buttons sit outside the role=button card and carry aria-label + title. Bookmark page cards may render the same-spec Remove-bookmark heart action (only when the item carries a bookmarkId).

components.name: Work Grid
components.description: auto-fill minmax(160px,1fr) grid with static skeleton blocks (no shimmer), empty/error/retry states and no-more footer.

components.name: Viewer Stage
components.description: Full-page artwork viewer stage on neutral near-black rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78); R-18 blur(24px) mask with confirm button remembered per session.

components.name: Novel Reader
components.description: 720px column, 14px/1.8 body, chapter headings 16px/700, sticky pager with page select; series table rows 48px+.

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Channel section headings are 16px/600 on-surface-variant; kind/period switches use secondary md-tabs; top-three ranking badges use primary-container.

components.name: Login Guard
components.description: Browse commands on a logged-out session return a fixed message and open the existing login dialog; browse views never re-implement login UI.

components.name: Browse Home Header
components.description: Browse home title row with the shuffle action vertically centered; auxiliary refresh actions stay at text-button level (md-text-button with an 18px stroke refresh icon), never outlined or filled.

components.name: Bookmark Page
components.description: Own-bookmarks page: type secondary tabs plus a public/private pill segmented toggle (surface-container track, primary-container selected); left sticky 180px tag rail (All row with summed count, tag rows with 12px/600 count badges, empty name shown as Untagged, wrapping to chips under 640px); right side total line + WorkGrid with hover Remove-bookmark action. Other users' public bookmarks (author tab) stay rest=show without the remove action.

components.name: Bookmark Button
components.description: Detail topbar bookmark trigger aligned to the outlined-button spec (40px pill, 18px heart): outline heart + Bookmark when empty, filled heart + Bookmarked with a Private badge when restrict=1; opens a native details popup (surface-container, 12px radius, the single legal overlay shadow) offering public/private add or remove; disabled with aria-busy while in flight, closes on outside pointerdown or Escape.

components.name: R18 Quick Filter
components.description: Channel-page top row: a Content filter label with three pill options (All / General / R-18); the pills use the same recipe as the discover page filter chips (transparent background, 1px outline at 60%, --ink text, 13px/600; selected = secondary-container / on-secondary-container with transparent border, hover = 8% on-surface state layer), the existing 4-12px spacing, no new tokens. Selection is expressed with aria-pressed, keyboard reachable, focus-visible primary 2px ring. Defaults to the global show_r18 setting; a manual choice covers only the current channel page (illustration / manga / novel keep independent states and never leak into each other) and never rewrites settings. Filtered works are hidden at render time only (no refetch); the hidden count reuses the auxiliary-line level (12px, --ink-subtle = outline role), never a heading level or a card badge; an all-filtered page does not change the server paging decision.

components.name: Fullscreen Viewer
components.description: Fullscreen overlay opened from the viewer stage: reuses the same neutral near-black rgb(0 0 0 / 0.78) backdrop as part of that single exception, defines no separate visual, and must not spread to ordinary content containers.

narrative.overview: A compact desktop tool that uses Material 3 color roles and Material Web controls for Pixiv capture tasks.

rules.name: The Material Role Rule
rules.body: Use existing M3 color roles rather than a second color system.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Primary never means success, failure or warning; error, warning, progress and task states always pair a readable label with the color.

rules.name: The Truncation Rule
rules.body: History table titles and authors ellipsize and keep a title attribute; other long text must not shrink in font size to buy space.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows identify menus and snackbar overlays, not routine cards.

rules.name: The Compact Task Rule
rules.body: Alignment, whitespace and wrapping serve scannability of tasks, history and settings rather than manufacturing large empty areas.

rules.name: The Native-First Rule
rules.body: Reuse Material Web and native semantics before adding local component styles.

dos: Use Material Web controls and M3 color roles.
Keep task state textual as well as colored.
Preserve the 640px responsive rules and reduced-motion override.
donts: Don't restore Naive UI or the prior blue-white design language.
Don't add shadows to ordinary cards.
Don't use primary as a success, warning or error color.
